front.title: Signer-Zone Containment for DNSSEC Wildcard Validation

author.organization: The University of Texas at Dallas

abstract.t: Validators for the DNS Security Extensions (DNSSEC) reconstruct the original owner name of a signed resource record set (RRset) using the RRSIG Labels field. This document updates RFC 4035 to make explicit how its existing signing-zone authority requirement applies to that reconstructed owner, and updates RFC 8198 to preserve the authenticated association between wildcard data, its original owner, and its signing zone during cache reuse. These clarifications prevent cryptographically correct signatures from being treated as authenticating wildcard sources outside the signing zone. They do not change DNS wildcard matching or synthesis rules, or DNS message formats.
